SI Scholarship for Global Professionals

Provider: Swedish Institute

Degree: Master's studies in Sweden

Field of study: eligible master's programmes including Computer Science

Funding Type: fully funded scholarship covering tuition fees, living expenses and a travel grant

Eligible Nationalities: citizens of eligible countries including Benin

Country of study: Sweden

Eligibility criteria: International applicants may apply from abroad. Applicants must have demonstrated work experience and demonstrated leadership experience from employment is required.

Deadline: 28 February 2031
